displayName: V2 Folder Scc Big Query Export

fields.label: Big Query Export ID
fields.help: This must be unique within the organization.

fields.label: Dataset
fields.help: The dataset to write findings' updates to.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Description
fields.help: The description of the notification config (max of 1024 characters).

fields.label: Filter
fields.help: Expression that defines the filter to apply across create/update events of findings.

fields.label: Folder
fields.help: The folder where Cloud Security Command Center Big Query Export Config lives in.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: The BigQuery export configuration is stored in this location.
